widgets_values:
Sampler MUST be euler and sigmas MUST come from the Apply node (trained PDD block boundaries). CFG 1.0 (BasicGuider). SigmaShift 12/3.

nfe 8 = trained; 4 also official. No turbo/distill LoRAs on top, no cache nodes (T8/EasyCache). Character LoRAs are fine.

Wrong sampler/scheduler stops with an explanatory error (on_off_grid=error).

采样器必须使用欧拉采样器，且 sigma 值必须来自应用节点（已训练的 PDD 块边界）。CFG 版本 1.0（BasicGuider）。SigmaShift 版本 12/3。

nfe 8 表示已训练；4 也为官方版本。顶部不使用 turbo/distill LoRA，也不使用缓存节点（T8/EasyCache）。字符型 LoRA 可以使用。

错误的采样器/调度器会导致程序停止并显示解释性错误（on_off_grid=error）。

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
  <Subject 1> is the female model from <Picture 1>, whose identity, face, hair, body proportions, and styling come from <Picture 1>.
  <Picture 2> is the body lotion bottle used in the scene.
  <Picture 3> is the bed and the setting for the scene.

summary:
  Create a high-fashion, sensual commercial. <Picture 1> supplies the character identity. <Picture 2> supplies the hero product. <Picture 3> supplies the setting. The video follows a continuous action of the woman applying lotion from <Picture 2> onto her legs while reclining on the bed from <Picture 3>.

retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1> (All shots): fully_preserved — face, hair, body, and outfit must remain identical to <Picture 1>.
  <Picture 2>: fully_preserved — the product's shape, color, logo, and details must never change.
  <Picture 3>: attribute_transfer — lighting and mood reference only.

detailed_description:
  [Shot 1] A wide, cinematic shot. <Subject 1> is reclining on the bed from <Picture 3>. She holds the body lotion bottle from <Picture 2> and begins to pour the white lotion onto her leg, which is raised in the air. The camera captures the scene from a side-angle.
  [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a close-up of the lotion being poured from the bottle into her palm. The texture is thick and creamy.
  [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, cut to a tight close-up of the lotion being applied to her leg. The hand rubs the lotion into the skin, showing the smooth texture and the glistening finish.
  [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, cut to a medium shot of <Subject 1> looking at the camera with a soft expression while continuing to massage the lotion into her legs.

overall_soundscape: Soft, rhythmic rubbing sounds of the lotion on skin, ambient room tone, and a light, upbeat pop track in the background.

non_diegetic_music: A modern, pop-inspired track with a steady beat and smooth, melodic vocals.

User modification to apply:
The woman in <Picture 1> sits on the bed from <Picture 3>, holding the body lotion from <Picture 2>. She pours the lotion onto her leg, which is raised in the air, and begins to massage it into her skin. The camera captures the scene from a side-angle, then cuts to a close-up of the lotion being poured and applied. The woman looks at the camera with a soft expression as she continues to massage the lotion into her legs.

Constraint: No third person. Only <Subject 1> appears in the video. There are no other people, animals, or objects in the scene besides the bed, the lotion bottle, and the woman's body.

widgets_values: fast_action 高速动作/打斗 (出拳/奔跑/转身)

═══ 推荐步数 ═══
关闭 Turbo，原生 20–24 步

═══ 注意力方案 ═══
Kitchen Attention 正确选择（动作镜头稳定，无撕裂）

═══ 参考权重 ═══
0.78–0.82（大姿态/转头/出拳，高权重会拉扯五官）（当前 0.85）

═══ 大动态负向词 ═══
clip 负面: 五官扭曲, 肢体穿模, 画面闪烁, 乱码文字, 画风突变, 肢体畸形, 手部崩坏, 画面撕裂

═══ FastH3 驱动配置 ═══
· vsa_enabled = 关（Dense 注意力，防边缘虚影/毛刺）
· video_keep_percent = 35%（VSA 保留 tile 百分比，越高细节损失越小）
· ladder = 999,749,500,250（FastH3 v0.2 训练 4 步阶梯，勿改）
· ref_length = 192（8s @ 24fps）→ 连 ReferenceToVideo/ImageToVideo.length

═══ 执行清单 ═══
① 拆段：单次生成 ≤8–15 秒（当前 8s → 建议再拆短），帧数砍半最直接
② 固定 seed + 用上一段结尾画面做参考首帧，分段接力生成
③ 动作镜头单独拆细；后期拼接处留 2–3 帧重叠，不硬切
④ 分辨率降一档（优先原生 1344×768），找稳定区间
⑤ 若加速后仍闪烁/颜色跳动：成片关掉全部加速重跑一版对比

═══ 后处理 ═══
· LTX2.5 二次采样放大（≈0.45 降噪）→ 修复动作镜头脸部模糊/残影
· SeedVR2 / FlashVSR / Topaz 超分 → 768P 母片提至 1080P/4K
· ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3：ER-SDE forecast 污染修复 + offline smoothing 去时序闪烁
· 分块超分注意接缝与时间闪烁：正常速度播放两遍再逐帧验眼/嘴/发际线
